capabilities: turn Markdown notes into Xiaohongshu covers
paginate note content into multi-page cards
disambiguation: Not a flashcard plugin; it creates Xiaohongshu cover and detail images from notes.
extras: Works in Obsidian desktop only; MIT licensed.
problem: Making Xiaohongshu cover and detail images from notes otherwise requires separate design tools and manual pagination.
summary: Obsidian workspace that turns Markdown notes into Xiaohongshu cover and multi-page PNG cards with templates and high-resolution export.
